intro: A Sealed Crate represents intercepted trade goods recovered from regional roadways and bandit hideouts. With thieves increasingly disrupting supply lines, trade handlers pay wandering adventurers to reclaim lost cargo and restore stability to the roads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your hard work, friend. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
